text:
samuel: noticed p95 spike on /rerank-vector since kernel-select rollout at ~1954320000. p95 went from ~120ms -> ~360ms.

maria: ugh. is this across all dims? which model and vector dim?

samuel: primarily dim=1536 model (reranker-v2). small batches (effective batch size median 2.1). QPS up slightly but not enough to explain p95 jump.

toni: perf-alert-bot flagged a regression: perf-alert-bot: [ALERT] rerank-vector_p95 > 300ms (5m)

alan: grabbed token-level breakdown: token_build: 8ms, kv_lookup: 220ms, kernel_exec: 30ms, postproc: 5ms. KV lookup went from ~30ms -> ~220ms at p95.

jessica: interesting — kernel selection change last night added a fast quantized kernel for seq_len<=128 but it also forces a different KV layout. maybe KV cache miss behavior changed.

samuel: below are the PromQL snippets I ran:

```
# qps for rerank endpoints by dim
sum(rate(redwood_requests_total{route="/rerank-vector",vector_dim=~"1536|2048"}[1m])) by (vector_dim)

# kv cache hit rate
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{route="/rerank-vector"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total{route="/rerank-vector"}[5m]))
```

jessica: result: kv hit rate dropped from ~0.92 -> ~0.61 for dim=1536 after the rollout window.

maria: do we have a flamegraph from the profiling run? maybe cache layout causing serial access or extra memcpy.

alan: uploaded a perf profile: https://perf.redwood.internal/shot/1954321100 (flamegraph shows large time in kv_lookup::deserialize_chain)

toni: can we try toggling batching_window_ms for rerank routes to 25ms? current is 12ms, causing many tiny micro-batches.

samuel: good idea. quick A/B: increased batching_window -> median effective batch size went 2.1 -> 5.0 and p95 fell to ~140ms in canary.

maria: is kernel selection still choosing the quantized path after that change?

jessica: yes, but with larger batches the quantized kernel behaves fine. The real issue looks like the interaction: small batch sizes + new KV layout => cache contention and extra deserializations.

samuel: proposal: 1) bump batching_window_ms to 25ms for /rerank-vector; 2) add a KV-layout fallback in kernel-select: if kv_hit_rate<0.8 choose legacy layout; 3) add token-level p95 alert for kv_lookup.

toni: +1, will coordinate a quick rollout for the batching change to canary group. If canary metrics hold, we'll push to prod.

perf-alert-bot: perf-alert-bot: [INFO] canary change deployed to 10% traffic for /rerank-vector

alan: I'll open a small PR for the kernel-select fallback (link: https://git.redwood/infer/ops/krn-fallback)

maria: thanks. Let's also add a dashboard panel for effective_batch_size and kv_hit_rate per route (token breakdown already exists but not per-route).

samuel: noted. tagging @oncall for visibility.

toni: oncall acknowledged. keeping an eye. :eyes: 

jessica: will follow up with a short postmortem if rollout goes badly or needs rollback.

samuel: thanks everyone. follow-ups: PRs + grafana panels + perf regression ticket.
